conceptPrompt:
Invent ONE brand-new Singapore/Malaysian hawker-food spirit FAMILY for the game Hawker Hunt.
It must be a real or highly plausible hawker dish, turned into a cute collectible monster family of 3 evolution stages.
Design goals: every dish must be UNIQUE (no collision with existing pets); may resemble the style but never be identical.
SPECIES FORM for this whole family (all 3 stages share it, but grow up): an upright bipedal BEAST-person: an animal head (e.g. tiger / lion / bear / fox / cat) on a humanoid body, standing on two legs with human-like arms. Stage 1 may be a rounder baby version, but stages 2–3 MUST be describable as an upright bipedal figure with arms/legs/claws clearly separate from the body (this is required so the 2D art can be auto-rigged into an animated 3D model). Write each stage's theme so an artist would naturally draw that upright, limbs-apart pose.
No specific direction — free creative choice.

Return JSON with: seriesId (ascii kebab-case, unique), foodOrigin {en,zh}, element (one of metal/wood/water/fire/earth), flavor (one of bitter/sour/salty/sweet/spicy per 五行五味), and stages: an array of EXACTLY 3 objects each { id (ascii kebab-case, unique per stage), stage (1|2|3), name{en,zh}, description{en,zh}, theme, skillIdeas[] }.
Keep every stage consistent with this art DNA: Chibi anthropomorphic Singapore hawker-food creature mascot, big expressive cartoon eyes, rounded soft chunky body, thick painterly cartoon shading with rich layered brushwork, soft rim light and glossy specular highlights (NOT flat vector, NOT realistic photo), appetising food-material rendering — crispy / juicy / glossy / caramelised surfaces with visible tactile texture and depth, high detail density and ornate finishing (armour trim, gems, sauce drips), scaling UP with evolution stage, strong three-dimensional volume and form, dramatic studio lighting, subtle ambient occlusion on the character, warm friendly collectible-monster design, full body head-to-toe, standing, slight 3/4 front view facing camera, cohesive with a unified premium collectible set of food spirits.


DO NOT duplicate any of these already-used dishes or names (you MAY be stylistically similar, but the dish, the name and the id MUST be distinct and unique):
Dishes: Hainanese Chicken Rice, 海南雞飯, Laksa, 叻沙, Bak Kut Teh, 肉骨茶, Kueh Lapis, 九層糕, Kaya Toast, 咖椰吐司, Chilli Crab, 辣椒蟹, Satay, 沙嗲, Kopi O, 咖啡烏, Chai Tow Kway, 菜頭粿, Rojak, 囉喏, Oyster Omelette, 蠔煎, Char Kway Teow, 炒粿條, Curry Puff, 咖喱卜, Roti Prata, 印度煎餅, Chendol, 煎蕊, Chilli Padi, 辣椒, Garlic, 蒜頭, Lemongrass, 香茅, Rice Ball, 飯團, Rice Vermicelli, 米粉, Egg, 雞蛋, Fresh Shrimp, 鮮蝦, Coconut Milk, 椰漿, Kueh Tutu, 嘟嘟糕, Nasi Lemak, 椰漿飯, Otak-Otak, 烏達

description.en: Concentrated essence of Chwee Kueh, fuel for evolution.
description.zh: 濃縮嘅水粿精華，進化嘅燃料。

description.en: A chubby little hamster spirit that lives in bamboo steamers. It has a soft, bouncy white body made of steamed rice flour and loves to nestle in warm, savory chai poh.
description.zh: 一隻圓滾滾的倉鼠精靈，生活在竹蒸籠裡。牠擁有蒸米粉製成的柔軟彈性白色身體，最喜歡窩在溫熱香鹹的菜脯裡。

stages.theme: A chibi bipedal hamster pup standing upright. Its body is smooth, white, and bouncy like freshly steamed rice cake. It wears a small bamboo steamer lid as a hat and has a tiny dab of glossy brown preserved radish (chai poh) on its head. Its arms and legs are small but clearly defined and separate from its body, spread out in a cute, balanced pose. It has large, glossy black eyes and shiny pink cheeks.

description.en: With a body hardened by perfect steaming, this bipedal hamster warrior proudly guards the hawker stall. It wears armor made of glazed ceramic saucers and carries a wooden paddle slick with chili oil.
description.zh: 經過完美蒸製淬鍊的雙足倉鼠戰士，自豪地守護著小販攤位。牠身穿釉面陶碗製成的鎧甲，手持沾滿辣椒油的木鏟。

stages.theme: An upright bipedal hamster soldier. Its white skin has a silky, matte-steamed texture. It wears a chest plate crafted from a classic shallow Chwee Kueh aluminum saucer, decorated with a thick layer of glistening, caramelized dark brown chai poh. It stands firmly on two legs with its arms spread, holding a wooden spatula weapon. Red chili oil drips artistically from its armor, catching the light with rich glossy specular highlights.

description.en: The ultimate guardian of the savory breakfast. This grand hamster shogun commands the earthen steam, clad in interlocking ceramic-plate armor dripping with sweet-savory chili oil and topped with an elite mound of fragrant caramelized radish.
description.zh: 美味早餐的終極守護者。這位雄偉的倉鼠大將掌控著大地的蒸氣，身披由多層陶碟連綴而成的重甲，甲冑上流淌著甜辣的紅油，並覆蓋著芬芳四溢的焦糖色炒菜脯。

stages.theme: The chwee kueh warrior REBORN as a majestic STEAM DEITY: a hamster-faced celestial god-general with a pure-white rice-cake body, two grand wings of swirling hot steam rising from its back, a tall tiered bamboo-steamer crown, a glowing halo, and a flowing regal cape of molten golden chili oil studded with caramelized chai poh. It wields a long ceremonial golden trident-fork held upright out to one side — a DIFFERENT weapon from the previous stage's spatula. Upright bipedal, arms and legs clearly visible and separate from the body.

description.en: A chubby little hamster spirit that lives in bamboo steamers. It has a soft, bouncy white body made of steamed rice flour and loves to nestle in warm, savory chai poh.
description.zh: 一隻圓滾滾的倉鼠精靈，生活在竹蒸籠裡。牠擁有蒸米粉製成的柔軟彈性白色身體，最喜歡窩在溫熱香鹹的菜脯裡。

description.en: Bounces forcefully out of its metal cup mold, crushing enemies beneath its heavy rice-cake body.
description.zh: 從金屬蒸杯中強力彈起，以厚實的水粿糕體重壓對手。

description.en: Flings a scatter of glistening, salty preserved radish to blind and sting enemies.
description.zh: 甩出一手油亮鹹香的碎菜脯，以濃郁的鹹氣刺痛並干擾敵方視線。

description.en: Summons a solid wall of compressed preserved radish to block attacks before shattering it forward as shrapnel.
description.zh: 召喚由緊實菜脯築成的堅固重盾，阻擋攻擊後將其震碎為飛石碎片痛擊前方。

description.en: Sweeps a giant flat bamboo spatula across the ground, tripping foes and launching them into the air.
description.zh: 揮舞巨型竹製水粿鏟橫掃地面，絆倒對手並將其鏟飛至半空。

description.en: Disperses a warm, aromatic cloud of garlic-infused oil to soothe wounds and boost ally defenses.
description.zh: 散發溫熱香濃的熟油與蒜香，為隊友療癒傷口並提升防禦力。

description.en: Unleashes a massive burst of scalding rice-scented steam from giant bamboo steamers to burn all opponents.
description.zh: 瞬間掀開巨型竹蒸籠，釋放高壓灼熱的米香蒸氣灼傷全體敵方。

description.en: Conjures a raging whirlwind of dark, sweet-and-salty caramelized radish that pummels the battlefield.
description.zh: 召喚狂暴的深色焦香醬油菜脯風暴，以排山倒海之勢無情痛擊整個戰場。
